outputs.explanation: This is a sequence conservation logo (letter-stack representation of amino acid frequencies across 120 proteins), not a plot of averaged measurements requiring individual data points.
The inhibition zone graph shows mean ± SEM bars/lines with individual gray dots overlaid for each biological replicate, as stated in the caption.
This panel consists of epifluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Fluorescence intensity is plotted as mean ± SEM with individual cell values shown as yellow open circles.
Fluorescence intensity is plotted as mean ± SEM with individual cell values shown as blue open circles.
This panel shows super-resolution PALM localization images of individual cells, not a summary plot of averaged data.
Number of clusters per cell is shown as mean ± SEM with individual cell values overlaid as gray dots.
